servicesPage.intro: From routine maintenance to major repairs, Dallas Auto Service offers a full range of automotive services for all makes and models. Our certified technicians use advanced tools and quality parts to ensure your vehicle runs safely and efficiently.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics & Repair
services.shortDescription: Accurate diagnostics and expert repairs for all engine issues.
services.longDescription: Our advanced diagnostic equipment identifies engine problems quickly. From check engine lights to performance issues, we provide thorough repairs using quality parts and proven techniques.
benefits: Restore engine performance and fuel efficiency
Prevent further damage with early detection

process.title: Computer Scan
process.description: We connect your vehicle to our diagnostic system to retrieve error codes and live data.

process.title: Inspection & Test
process.description: Our technician performs a visual inspection and road test to confirm the issue.

process.title: Repair & Verify
process.description: We complete the repair and re-test to ensure everything is working properly.

faqs.question: How long does an engine diagnostic take?
faqs.answer: Most diagnostics take about 1-2 hours, depending on the complexity of the issue.

faqs.question: Do you service all car brands?
faqs.answer: Yes, we work on all makes and models, including domestic, Asian, and European vehicles.

services.title: Brake Service
services.shortDescription: Complete brake inspection, repair, and replacement.
services.longDescription: Your safety depends on reliable brakes. We inspect pads, rotors, calipers, and fluid to ensure optimal stopping power. We use premium parts and provide honest recommendations.
benefits: Free brake inspection with any service

process.title: Visual Inspection
process.description: We check pad thickness, rotor condition, and brake fluid levels.

process.title: Measurement & Test
process.description: We measure rotor runout and perform a road test to assess performance.

process.title: Service & Adjustment
process.description: We replace worn parts, bleed fluid if needed, and adjust for proper feel.

faqs.question: How often should I replace my brake pads?
faqs.answer: Typically every 30,000-50,000 miles, but it depends on driving habits and conditions.

faqs.question: What are signs of brake problems?
faqs.answer: Squealing, grinding, a soft pedal, or vibration when braking are common indicators.

services.title: Oil Change & Fluid Services
services.shortDescription: Regular oil changes and fluid maintenance to extend engine life.
services.longDescription: Keep your engine running smoothly with our comprehensive oil change service. We use high-quality synthetic and conventional oils, and check all other fluids to ensure your car stays in top condition.
benefits: Complimentary fluid top-off with every oil change

process.title: Drain Old Oil
process.description: We safely drain the used oil and dispose of it responsibly.

process.title: Replace Filter
process.description: A new oil filter is installed to ensure clean oil circulation.

process.title: Refill & Check
process.description: We add the correct amount of oil and check all other fluid levels.

faqs.question: How often should I get an oil change?
faqs.answer: Most vehicles need an oil change every 5,000-7,500 miles, but check your owner's manual.

faqs.question: Do you use synthetic oil?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer both conventional and synthetic oil options to meet your vehicle's needs.

services.title: Tire Services
services.shortDescription: Tire rotation, balancing, and replacement for a smooth ride.
services.longDescription: Proper tire maintenance is essential for safety and handling. We offer tire rotation, balancing, and new tire installation. Our technicians help you choose the right tires for your driving needs.
benefits: Even tire wear for longer tire life
Free tire pressure check with rotation

process.title: Inspection
process.description: We check tire condition, tread depth, and air pressure.

process.title: Rotation & Balancing
process.description: Tires are rotated according to manufacturer patterns and balanced to prevent vibration.

process.title: Installation & Alignment Check
process.description: We mount new tires if needed and recommend alignment if necessary.

faqs.question: When should I rotate my tires?
faqs.answer: Every 5,000-8,000 miles, or as recommended by your vehicle manufacturer.

faqs.question: How do I know if I need new tires?
faqs.answer: If tread depth is below 2/32 inch, or if you see cracks, bulges, or uneven wear.

about.headline: Dallas Auto Service: Your Trusted Local Mechanic
about.mission: To provide honest, high-quality auto repair and maintenance with transparent communication and fair pricing, ensuring every customer leaves satisfied and safe on the road.
story: Founded over two decades ago, Dallas Auto Service started as a small garage with a big commitment to quality. Our founder, a certified master technician, believed that every car deserved expert care and every customer deserved honest advice. From day one, we focused on building trust through transparent diagnostics and fair pricing, earning a loyal following among Dallas drivers.

Today, we continue that tradition with a team of ASE-certified technicians and state-of-the-art equipment. We treat every vehicle as if it were our own, and every customer as a neighbor. Whether it's a simple oil change or a complex engine repair, we bring the same dedication to excellence. We're proud to be a part of the Dallas community and look forward to serving you.
